submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 gave the highest simulated signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocation. At 35 GeV it reached 91.8%, against 83.7% for L1 and 74.3% for L3. For L2 I scanned 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 GeV. Efficiency peaked at 30 GeV (92.6%). The other points were 86.7%, 89.7%, 91.8% and 90.4%. I did not scan L1 or L3 at other thresholds. Their 2025 and 35 GeV results were well below L2, so I assumed they would stay below it. The documents do not state the Level-1 latency budget. That is a residual risk for L2, because it is the most complex algorithm.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm is one of the three candidates

requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md says all candidates fit the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs), and links.md says the optical links have enough bandwidth. No document gives a latency budget or L2 timing, so latency is unverified.

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at the allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: L2 at 30 GeV gave 92.6% in simulation. L1 gave 83.7% and L3 gave 74.3%, both at 35 GeV.
